statement: ∀ (t : ℝ), NormedSpace.exp (t • !![0, 1; -2, -2]) = rexp (-t) • !![cos t + sin t, sin t; -2 * sin t, cos t - sin t]
script:
# name: de-exp-spiral-sink-test
# technique: test a claim no recipe certifies, at instances Sage evaluates exactly or in interval arithmetic
#   (test_fallback recipe, oracle instances; the binders are functions, matrices or need exact symbolic values)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.DifferentialEquations.LinearSystemComputations.exp_spiral_sink file "de-exp-spiral-sink-test.sage"
# description: e^{tA} for A = (0, 1; -2, -2) by Sage at t = 0 (edge), 1, 2
SEED = 0  # the instances are listed by hand
x = SR.var('x')
RIF = RealIntervalField(64)
def B(c):
    return ZZ(1) if bool(c) else ZZ(0)
t_ = var('t_')
def nf(e):
    return SR(e).expand().simplify_full().rectform().simplify_full()
def Z(L, R):
    return ZZ(1) if all(nf(e) == 0 for e in (matrix(SR, L) - matrix(SR, R)).list()) else ZZ(0)
A2 = matrix(QQ, [[0, 1], [-2, -2]])
J = matrix(QQ, [[0, 1], [-1, 0]])
N = matrix(QQ, [[0, 1], [0, 0]])
instances = [
    oracle_instance('0',
                    lhs=Z(((t_)*matrix(SR, [[0,1],[-2,-2]])).exp().apply_map(lambda e: e.simplify_full()).subs(t_=0), exp(-(0))*matrix(SR, [[cos(0)+sin(0), sin(0)], [-2*sin(0), cos(0)-sin(0)]])),
                    rhs=1, relation='==', edge=True),
    oracle_instance('1',
                    lhs=Z(((t_)*matrix(SR, [[0,1],[-2,-2]])).exp().apply_map(lambda e: e.simplify_full()).subs(t_=1), exp(-(1))*matrix(SR, [[cos(1)+sin(1), sin(1)], [-2*sin(1), cos(1)-sin(1)]])),
                    rhs=1, relation='==', edge=False),
    oracle_instance('2',
                    lhs=Z(((t_)*matrix(SR, [[0,1],[-2,-2]])).exp().apply_map(lambda e: e.simplify_full()).subs(t_=2), exp(-(2))*matrix(SR, [[cos(2)+sin(2), sin(2)], [-2*sin(2), cos(2)-sin(2)]])),
                    rhs=1, relation='==', edge=False),
]
